t.55965-84-9.agn: Present in products at very low concentrations; at these levels the acute toxicity and corrosivity classes of the pure mixture do not carry over to the label. It is a skin sensitiser (Skin Sens. 1A) and often causes contact allergy. It must be listed by name on the detergent label as a preservative.
t.55965-84-9.pw.0: A preservative that often causes contact allergy; if you are allergic to isothiazolinones, look for it on the label.
t.55965-84-9.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 613-167-00-5 (ATP13): Acute Tox. 2 (Inhalation), Acute Tox. 2 (Dermal), Acute Tox. 3 (Oral), Skin Corr. 1C, Eye Dam. 1, Skin Sens. 1A, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 1. Supplemental label statement: EUH071.
t.55965-84-9.reg.det: Must be listed by name (INCI) on the detergent label as a preservative, whatever its concentration.
t.55965-84-9.summary: A 3:1 mixture of two isothiazolinones; a preservative (biocide).
t.55965-84-9.what: Stops bacteria and fungi from growing in water-based products.
t.tem.h.H310: H310 Fatal in contact with skin.
